reauth_confirm.title: Log in to NAUC.link again
reauth_confirm.description: The NAUC.link session stored in Home Assistant is no longer valid. Log in again to keep your sensors updating.

abort.already_configured: This NAUC.link account is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: A login for NAUC.link is already in progress.

data_description.broken_link_repairs: Raise a notice in Settings → Repairs for each broken link. The Broken links sensor lists them either way.

broken_link.title: Broken link: {name}
broken_link.description:
The link **{name}** ({short_url}) points to {destination}, which is failing ({reason}). Anyone scanning its QR code or opening it lands on an error.

Open it in NAUC.link to change its destination. This notice clears by itself once the destination works again.
